# Test: apx pathlint reads an external prefix from a flag or from a binding
# (native Go, no external tools; the inputs are plain YAML files)

# Without a prefix, the base path of the spec applies and the paths drift
! exec apx pathlint --ingress ingress.yaml --spec spec.yaml
stdout 'RESULT: FAIL \(undeclared=1 unreachable=1 matched_pairs=0\)'
stdout '/internal/v2/things +spec=spec.yaml base="/internal/v2"'

# --warn-only keeps the report and exits 0
exec apx pathlint --ingress ingress.yaml --spec spec.yaml --warn-only
stdout 'RESULT: WARN \(--warn-only\)'

# --external-prefix replaces the base path
exec apx pathlint --ingress ingress.yaml --spec spec.yaml --external-prefix /api/v2
stdout 'RESULT: PASS \(undeclared=0 unreachable=0 matched_pairs=1\)'

# --binding takes the prefix of the API; one API needs no id
exec apx pathlint --ingress ingress.yaml --spec spec.yaml --binding binding.yaml
stdout 'RESULT: PASS'

# The spec can name its API
exec apx pathlint --ingress ingress.yaml --spec openapi/things/v2=spec.yaml --binding binding.yaml
stdout 'RESULT: PASS'

# The JSON report
exec apx pathlint --ingress ingress.yaml --spec spec.yaml --binding binding.yaml --format json
stdout '"result": "PASS"'
stdout '"matchedPairs": 1'
stdout '"unreachable": \[\]'
! exec apx pathlint --ingress ingress.yaml --spec spec.yaml --format json
stdout '"result": "FAIL"'
stdout '"base": "/internal/v2"'
exec apx pathlint --ingress ingress.yaml --spec spec.yaml --format json --warn-only
stdout '"result": "WARN"'

# Errors
! exec apx pathlint --ingress ingress.yaml --spec spec.yaml --binding binding.yaml --external-prefix /api/v2
stderr 'cannot be used together'
! exec apx pathlint --ingress ingress.yaml --spec openapi/other/v1=spec.yaml --binding binding.yaml
stderr 'API openapi/other/v1 is not in the binding'
! exec apx pathlint --ingress ingress.yaml --spec spec.yaml --external-prefix api
stderr 'invalid --external-prefix'
! exec apx pathlint --ingress ingress.yaml --spec spec.yaml --format xml
stderr 'invalid --format'

-- ingress.yaml --
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: things
spec:
  rules:
    - http:
        paths:
          - path: /api/v2
            pathType: Prefix
-- spec.yaml --
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Things
  version: "2"
servers:
  - url: https://things.example.com/internal/v2
paths:
  /things:
    get:
      operationId: listThings
      responses:
        '200': {description: ok}
-- binding.yaml --
apiVersion: appkit.infoblox.dev/v1alpha1
kind: AppContract
metadata:
  name: things
  namespace: things
spec:
  provides:
    apis:
      - name: things
        ref: apx://openapi/things/v2@v2.0.0
        serviceName: things
        routes:
          externalPrefix: /api/v2
          targetRefs:
            - {group: networking.k8s.io, kind: Ingress, name: things}
